content.text:
Repaired and resubmitted.

**Change made in response to the verifier:** the refund element is now carried in operative language inside the new § 9.4 rather than relying on § 10.2, which refunds only "prepaid recurring Fees covering the period after termination" (not expressly pro rata, and silent on prepaid implementation, professional-services and usage amounts).

**Final proposal (preferred level, two ops):**
1. **New § 9.4** — "Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience upon thirty days' prior written notice to Vendor, in which case Vendor shall refund, on a pro-rata basis, all prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience during a committed term." Numbered 9.4 (the slot the document skips), covering preferred elements 1–4.
2. **§ 2.1** — "without reduction **rights but subject to Customer's** termination rights", removing the contradiction with the new right while preserving the Customer-favourable no-reduction restriction.

Notice stays at 30 days (preferred) rather than being lengthened into the 60–90 day fallback band; §§ 9.1–9.3 and 9.5 survive unchanged and no cross-reference is left dangling.
